thread:
julian: Quick notes from the prototype sessions today for API Keys. Two new asks kept coming up: a way to "preview impact" of chosen scopes, and a less scary revoke path (people want to stage revokes).

harpreet: Love "preview impact" 1 can you describe what participants expected to see?

julian: They wanted a tiny live panel that shows example API calls and expected responses for current scope selections. One line summary + one collapsible code sample per endpoint: e.g. `Embeddings -> 200`, `Generate -> 403`. They called it a "scope explorer".

zoe: UX idea: include an "impact simulator" toggle. When on, the panel shows simulated failed requests you might hit after changes, with suggested mitigations (use service account, switch to embeddings-only). It felt reassuring.

omar: For revoke, testers preferred a "staging" flow: mark key as staged-for-revoke (UI shows orange), which disables new key creation but keeps existing tokens valid for a configurable window. Then finalise revoke after verifying no errors. 

harpreet: Implementation detail: we can reuse the existing rotate endpoint semantics for staging by adding a `staged=true` flag; backend already supports soft deletes in audit. Need eng to confirm.

ux-bot: Accessibility reminders: announce changes to the scope explorer with aria-live; if the impact simulator toggles results, ensure focus remains logical and all examples are keyboard reachable.

julian: Copy tweaks: avoid frightening verbs. Replace "Revoke now" primary with "Stage revoke (10m)" and put a danger action "Revoke immediately" in an overflow menu. Participants consistently preferred the less final-sounding label.

zoe: Mobile quirk: people couldn't easily copy rotated secrets on small devices. Suggestion: show a QR code along with the copy button when rotating so devs can scan to transfer to phone auth managers. Kinda neat and unexpected.

omar: For rotation UX: after rotate, show a short checklist: Copy secret, Update CI, Restart jobs. Banner should be focusable and persist until user dismisses or checks the checklist. Also show a small link "Show example update for GitHub Actions" which expands a snippet.

harpreet: Audit defaults: we prototyped a per-key "record to audit" toggle. Researchers liked audit ON by default for org-admins, off for regular users but visible with microcopy: "Admins: events are recorded to org audit logs."

ux-bot: Accessibility nit: when the secret drawer opens, move focus to the primary CTA (Copy) and set a polite aria-live message: "API key secret displayed. Use Copy to save it. This secret will not be shown again."

julian: One more thing: add a small inline "Why would I pick this preset?" link next to each preset that opens a one-line rationale and a single example API call. Users said this reduced cognitive load more than long docs.

zoe: Anything contentious? I pushed a tiny suggestion to the figma where presets are chips that expand below rather than a modal overflow. People liked that.

omar: No major objections. I'll check with infra on staged revoke implementation and QR encoding the secret securely. Need to ensure we mark QR as ephemeral and disable screenshots on mobile if possible.

harpreet: I'll update copy + a11y notes and drop frames into #design-review by EOD. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
